propositions: Auto-deploy container restart mid-review causes the shutdown drain (45s) to timeout before the in-flight review completes (260-911s observed), resulting in a fail-closed LLM-Review -1 that blocks the backfill reconciler
Increase DEFAULT_SHUTDOWN_DRAIN_SECONDS from 45 to 1200 seconds (matching review timeout) and resize docker-compose stop_grace_period to 1320s to allow in-flight reviews to complete gracefully
For retryable coverage-gap conditions (review-error, llm-unavailable, scanner, gate-disabled), defer posting a vote and record an attempt, leaving the change vote-less for the reconciler to re-drive
After RETRYABLE_GAP_MAX_ATTEMPTS (default 3) consecutive failures on the same change/revision, escalate by casting a fail-closed -1 vote with exhausted-retries note and emitting VOTER_ERROR metric
Thread gap_reason from adapter decision logic to voter, and add review_attempts ledger table keyed on (change_id, revision) with record/count/reset operations
Teardown-mid-review is discriminated as retryable (no vote) rather than terminal, while indeterminate and finding verdicts remain terminal (vote -1)
